business_description.value: Holori provides a FinOps and cloud infrastructure visibility platform that centralizes, visualizes, allocates, monitors, and optimizes cloud costs and infrastructure across providers including AWS, Azure, GCP, and Oracle.

cloud_signals.value: Holori operates a customer-facing cloud platform with an application available at app.holori.com.
Holori connects to customers' AWS, GCP, and Azure environments to generate infrastructure diagrams, monitor changes, and display resource configurations and costs.
Holori centralizes multi-provider cloud costs, provides dashboards and reports, and offers cost optimization recommendations and allocation features.
